en.title: Pronouncing Nu Mai Quickly
en.summary: Learn how to say (nu mai) /nu maj/ smoothly with weak stress on the second word.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: Listen to the phrase (nu mai) /nu maj/, which means no more. The word (nu) /nu/ means not. The word (mai) /maj/ means more. Together, they sound like one unit. You hear strong stress on (nu) /nu/. The following sound is weak and fast.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Start with your lips rounded for (nu) /nu/. Say it with a clear, steady voice. Next, move quickly to (mai) /maj/. Open your mouth for 'ah' and glide to 'ee'. Do not push extra air out. Keep the pitch high on (nu) /nu/ and drop it fast on (mai) /maj/.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: You see two words in writing: (nu mai) /nu maj/. In speech, you connect them without a pause. Treat them like one word with two parts. Put your main focus on (nu) /nu/. Glide through (mai) /maj/ very quickly. The two words always flow together like a single breath.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pause between the two words. Some people give equal force to each part. That makes speech sound stiff and unnatural. Do not stress (mai) /maj/. If you make it strong, it sounds heavy. Say (nu) /nu/ clearly and let (mai) /maj/ follow weakly. Keep the pace brisk and natural.
